name: Simplifi by Quicken
description: Quicken Simplifi is a personal-finance app for viewing accounts, transactions, bills, subscriptions, savings goals, spending plans, and projected cash flow. People use it to organize a household financial picture and make day-to-day budgeting decisions across web and mobile.
agentUseSummary: Quicken Simplifi does not publish a supported third-party user-data API, so Relay does not capture Quicken credentials, automate private clients, or expose agent actions.

providerSetup.blocker: Simplifi by Quicken's official product and support surfaces do not publish a developer application, delegated authorization flow, account API, or webhook contract for third-party access.
providerSetup.nextAction: Reassess only if Simplifi by Quicken publishes an official third-party developer program and documented authorization and account-data APIs.

evidence.supports: Quicken presents Simplifi as a consumer personal-finance product for budgets, accounts, bills, goals, and cash-flow planning.
The official Simplifi support center documents customer workflows but does not publish third-party application registration, user authorization, scopes, or account-data API endpoints.
Simplifi documents OAuth as the way Simplifi connects outward to financial institutions; it does not offer OAuth for third parties to access a Simplifi account.
